identity_boundary: Han Kwang Hyok is the person MSMT lists as associated with the Laos-based SANS FAB/Sangsin IT delegation as of mid-2024 and in Annex 14 as relocating from Laos to China in late 2024. The source covers the reported association and movement; present location, completed return to North Korea, delegation role, civil identity beyond the source name, and present account control fall outside that source scope. Similar records stay separate until a source explicitly links them by name, nationality, geography, technology, or image.
